name: Kindred

description.content: While you are hooked, all Survivors see each other's Auras, and the Killer's Aura within [16m] of your Hook.
Whenever another Survivor is hooked, you see the Auras of all Survivors, and the Killer's Aura within [16m] of their Hook.

quote: "Be kind to one another. We're all in this together." -Lost Tapes: Sujan
